evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Utrzymanie systemu BI na wysokim poziomie dostępności
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Data quality, consistency of the BI system, availability and documentation are the only register and there is no speed language, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Zakupy w naszych sklepach na preferencyjnych warunkach
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A retail group (the benefits mention staff purchases in its shops) with no regulatory language, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Utrzymywanie spójności systemu BI wraz ze zmianami w procesach firmy
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing BI system and data warehouse being kept consistent as the business changes reads as mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Projektowanie i implementacja rozwiązań BI, hurtowni danych i baz analitycznych
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities are generic (design and implement BI solutions, create reports) with the tools only in the requirements, so recruiter.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Współpraca z biznesem w zakresie definiowania wymagań
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The work centres on the BI platform, warehouse and reports; the business is named only generically, so internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Projektowanie i budowa raportów, dashboardów i wizualizacja danych
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Design, build, maintain and document scoped BI deliverables, with autonomy only as a trait in the requirements, so execution.
evidence.testing_framing: Tworzenie procesów ETL/ELT i zarządzanie jakością danych
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Managing data quality is an assigned responsibility alongside building the ETL/ELT processes, though no testing tool is named.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Delivery and maintenance tasks with no risk, compliance or incident register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Design and implementation sit beside maintaining the BI system, so mixed.
evidence.ats_lookup: resolve_ats miss; web search found no SMYK careers posting, only other firms' BI developer roles in Warsaw
